title: 第一卷 第8章 化身老黄牛，把地给翻一遍
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

萧临戍头都不敢回，他怕自己上去啃两口。

“不，不用，你什么都不用做，我是找老婆，找伴侣，不是找保姆的，以后家里什么都，都有我！”

这谁受得了，不是说建国后不许成精吗？

小妖精，早晚，哼哼！

“你先去写信吧，等会我给你寄出去。”

“好！”

季望棉满意了。

嘴巴能让她舒服的话，何乐而不为，她最不吝啬的就是说话。

季望棉拿着纸笔模仿原主的性格写了一封信，大概就是报喜不报忧。

拿出一百块钱放在信中间，叠起来。

没有其他原因，季望棉就是舍不得。

手里有钱心不慌，等她站稳脚跟了再说吧！

不知道是不是刺激过头了，萧临戍始终跟她保持半米的距离，季望棉知道，对方的余光一直在偷看自己。

小样，轻易就被姐拿下了！

萧临戍隔着墙喊王大姐。

临走前又不放心地叮嘱，千万别走丢了。

季望棉乖巧的说好，还让萧临戍训练的时候注意安全，反正萧临戍走的时候是头重脚轻，飘着走的。

王芬华看见站在门口的季望棉，一时都忘了自己还有嗓子，嘴巴张张合合，好半天才找到自己的嗓子，憋出一句：“你，你好！”

乖乖，这长得也太好看了，她没文化，搜肠刮肚只能用仙女形容了。

她都怕自己这张脸丑到对方。

早知道涂点蛤蜊油了。

“唉呀妈呀，妈，你这啥动静啊，吓得我直哆嗦，你是我妈吗？”

“肯定有脏东西上咱妈身了，大哥，你给妈叫叫。”

“那你给我搬个凳子，我站高点，哎呦揪揪耳朵吓不着，摸摸毛吓不着。”

两个小孩一唱一和，王芬华一张脸瞬间涨红：“你们俩给我闭嘴！小兔崽子，我让你叭叭叭。”

伸手就要抓住一个打屁股，两人一哄而散。

“大哥，咱妈回来了！”

“肯定是脏东西上身发现是个母老虎又吓跑了！”

“哈哈哈，母老虎，昨天晚上咱爸还说呢，要武松打母老虎。”

“我也听见了，打得可激烈了，床都咯吱响，都散架了！”

“没散架，我早上去看了，好好的呢！咱妈身子骨真好，挨打了第二天还能骂人。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xiao Linshu didn't dare to look back, he was afraid that he would go up and take a bite.

"No, no, you don't have to do anything. I'm looking for a wife, a partner, not a nanny. From now on, everything in the house will be with me!"

Who can bear this? Didn't they say that after the founding of the People's Republic of China, they were not allowed to become sperms?

Little goblin, sooner or later, hum!

"You go ahead and write a letter. I will send it to you later."

"Okay!"

Ji Wangmian was satisfied.

If her mouth can make her feel comfortable, why not? The thing she is most generous with is talking.

Ji Wangmian took a pen and paper and wrote a letter imitating the character of the original owner, probably reporting good news rather than bad news.

Take out a hundred dollars, put it in the middle of the letter, and fold it.

For no other reason, Ji Wangmian just couldn't bear it.

Don’t panic if you have money in hand, let’s wait until she gets a firm footing!

I don't know if it was too much stimulation, but Xiao Linshu always kept half a meter away from her. Ji Wangmian knew that the other party had been peeking at her from the corner of his eye.

The demo was easily taken down by my sister!

Xiao Linshu called Sister Wang across the wall.

Before leaving, he warned me not to get lost.

Ji Wangmian agreed obediently and asked Xiao Linshu to pay attention to safety during training. Anyway, Xiao Linshu was top-heavy and floating when he walked.

Wang Fenhua saw Ji Wangmian standing at the door. For a moment, she forgot that she still had a voice. She opened and closed her mouth. It took her a long time to find her voice and hold back a sentence: "Hello!"

Darling, she is so pretty. She is uneducated and can only be described as a fairy.

She was afraid that her face would make him ugly.

I wish I'd put some clam oil on it.

"Oh my god, mom, what are you doing? It makes me tremble with fear. Are you my mother?"

"There must be something dirty on our mother. Brother, please call her."

"Then you bring me a stool. I'll stand higher. You can't scare me by pulling my ears or touching my fur."

The two children sang in harmony, and Wang Fenhua's face turned red instantly: "Shut up, you two! Little bastards, I'll let you bab bab bab."

Reaching out to grab a spanker, the two of them dispersed.

"Brother, our mother is back!"

"The dirty thing must have caught on and found out it was a tigress and scared him away!"

"Hahaha, tigress, last night our dad even said that he wanted Wu Song to beat the tigress."

"I heard it too. The beating was so fierce that the bed creaked and fell apart!"

"It's not falling apart. I went to see her this morning. She's fine! My mother is in such good health that she could still curse the next day after being beaten."
